name: AKT–FOXO signaling in IGF response and cell death
rationale: All members concern PI3K/AKT control of FOXO activity and its outputs; unlike confusables (HSF1 heat shock, NFE2L2, p53/mTORC1) the theme adds IGF/peptide response, apoptotic signaling and muscle atrophy.

core: DNA structural remodeling during replication and repair
name: DNA topology and fork remodeling in replication and repair
rationale: Members share changes to DNA conformation and protein-DNA complexes at forks, telomeres and repair sites; DNA topological/geometric change distinguishes it from chromatin-remodeling and telomere confusables.

qualifier: positive and negative control of inflammatory cytokine output
name: Regulation of TLR signaling and inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members regulate TLR/IL-1/CD40 signaling and the IL-6, IL-1, TNF, IL-10, IL-12 cytokines they induce; confusables instead cover inflammasomes/LPS detection, TAK1/IKK adaptor steps or T-cell NF-kB restraint.

name: Promotion of sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial proliferation
rationale: All members promote endothelial sprouting, proliferation, migration and branching, whereas confusables are dominated by negative regulation or VEGF production.

name: Proline, glycine and glyoxylate amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid metabolic terms centred on proline, glycine and glyoxylate, distinguishing it from serine/B6, aromatic and histidine/threonine confusables.

name: Double-strand break repair with end resection and BRCA defects
rationale: Members span DSB sensing, resection, HR, NHEJ, MMEJ and SSA; the end-processing steps and BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2/BARD1 loss-of-function variants are absent from the confusables.

name: E2F-controlled origin licensing and replication initiation
rationale: Members cover origin licensing (ORC, CDC6, pre-RC), replication initiation and its checkpoint under E2F control, unlike confusables centred on general cell-cycle or G1/S transcription.
Members are three unrelated promoter-motif sets, glucocorticoid receptor targets and two unrelated BTM modules (platelet; vascular adhesion signaling) with no shared biological process.

name: Reelin-driven dendrite, spine and synapse maturation
rationale: Members concern dendrite/spine maintenance, synapse maturation and plasticity with Reelin signaling; confusables lack Reelin or carry amyloid/LTP and actin terms instead.

qualifier: classical RHOA/B/C, CDC42, RHOG and formin effectors
name: Classical Rho and CDC42 GTPase cycles with formin activation
rationale: Members are RHOA/B/C/D/G/J and CDC42 cycles plus formin activation, while confusables hold atypical RHOU/V, RND, RHOF, IQGAP or macropinocytosis terms.

name: ESCRT-mediated viral budding and non-lytic virion release
rationale: All members describe enveloped virus budding/release via the MVB-ESCRT machinery, distinct from ESCRT in cytokinesis and nuclear envelope sealing or HIV Nef/Vpu confusables.

name: TLR3–TBK1–IRF3 signaling and herpes simplex encephalitis deficiencies
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR trafficking, TBK1/IKKe activation of IRF3/7 and TLR3/TICAM1/TRAF3/UNC93B1 deficiencies in HSE, unlike broad interferon/RLR/cGAS confusables.

qualifier: brush border, tight junctions and raft sorting
name: Apical brush border, tight junction and raft protein sorting
rationale: Members concern apical membrane identity: microvilli, polarized Golgi-to-membrane sorting, raft localization and tight junction/paracellular transport, unlike CFTR/bile transport or podocyte polarity confusables.

core: Host regulation of viral life cycle
name: Host regulation of viral entry, spread and release
rationale: Members are generic regulation of viral entry, transport and release, while confusables name specific viruses or viral genome replication.

name: Ephrin and L1CAM signaling in axon guidance and fasciculation
rationale: Members cover ephrin repulsion, L1 signaling/recycling, DCC attraction and RAC1 activation in axon guidance, distinct from netrin-repulsion and Robo-Slit confusables.

name: Retrograde endosome-to-Golgi and COPI-independent ER traffic
rationale: Members concern retrieval of cargo from endosomes to the TGN, Golgi retention and COPI-independent retrograde transport, unlike anterograde Golgi-to-lysosome or COPI confusables.

qualifier: with protein import and cristae biogenesis
name: Oxidative phosphorylation with mitochondrial protein import and cristae biogenesis
rationale: Members cover respiratory chain assembly, ATP synthesis and Fe-S clusters plus protein import, processing, cristae and calcium uptake; confusables lack either OXPHOS or the import/membrane terms and add heme or translation.

name: Mesoderm migration and lateral plate patterning at gastrulation
rationale: Members concern germ-layer formation, mesodermal migration and lateral plate derivatives (heart, pericardium, gut), unlike endoderm/primitive-streak or cardiogenesis confusables.

name: Calcium-triggered synaptic vesicle fusion and short-term potentiation
rationale: Members regulate calcium-dependent synaptic vesicle fusion, spontaneous release and short-term potentiation, distinct from docking/priming, transmitter-specific release cycles or presynaptic calcium confusables.

name: Growth hormone–IGF and thyroid hormone control of growth
rationale: Members combine GH receptor/JAK-STAT and IGF signaling with thyroid hormone transport and action; confusables have only one arm or add leptin/prolactin.

name: Glutamate, aspartate and alanine metabolism feeding gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members are glutamate/glutamine, aspartate and alanine metabolism linked to oxaloacetate and gluconeogenesis, unlike TCA, glycine-conjugation or proline confusables.

qualifier: with PAPS sulfonation and selenium metabolism
name: Thyroid hormone synthesis with PAPS sulfonation and selenium metabolism
rationale: Members cover iodide transport, H2O2 generation and thyroid hormone activity together with PAPS-dependent sulfonation and selenium reduction; PAPS sulfonation distinguishes it from SLC26 and selenocysteine confusables.

qualifier: tachykinin signaling in reproductive and urinary tracts
name: Tachykinin-driven visceral smooth muscle contraction in reproduction and micturition
rationale: Members concern smooth muscle contraction/relaxation in reproductive, urinary and gut organs with tachykinin receptor signaling, unlike gastric motility or adrenergic vascular confusables.

name: Nephron proximal–distal patterning and distal tubule development
rationale: Members cover nephron patterning, comma/S-shaped body and distal tubule, loop of Henle and collecting duct development, whereas confusables cover intermediate mesoderm, MET or ureteric bud.

name: Cardiac conduction system development and cardiomyocyte fate commitment
rationale: Members concern SA node, AV node/canal and His-Purkinje development with cardioblast fate, unlike chamber/septum morphogenesis or conduction-physiology confusables.
